crm_notes: Summary: Mid-market B2B SaaS that embeds ML-powered support + knowledge features into their product. Completed 6-week Hosted API trial; now evaluating Dedicated for cost predictability and VPC requirement.
Key contacts: VP Product - Elena Rossi (exec sponsor), Eng Manager - Tom Beck, Data Lead - Priya Rao.
Trial results (hosted API): steady-state QPS ~25 during PST business hours; observed peaks up to ~120 QPS during email campaign spikes (2026-02-18 spike).
Token mix observed: average prompt tokens 320, average completion tokens 190; embeddings traffic ~8% of total calls but high CPU-burst pattern.
Concurrency: average concurrency per API key ~6, but product workflows (multi-turn chat + rerank) cause effective per-session concurrency ~12 for short windows.
Traffic breakdown: chat/generation 68%, reranking 18%, embeddings 8%, misc tooling calls 6%.
Quality needs: 90% of support responses OK at 7B model; 10% high-sensitivity flows (billing/legal) require 13B-class model and stricter audit logging.
Security: require SSO/SAML for admin console, audit logs retained 1 year, KMS integration for customer keys, data residency for EU customers (will need region pinning).
POC milestones: hosted integration (done), instrumentation & tracing (done), cost burn analysis (done), Dedicated sizing workshop (scheduled).

Technical findings (from POC logs):
- Average end-to-end latency (hosted): 220ms median, 95th ~650ms for generation flows at steady load.
- Prefix caching reduced token spend for help-article retrieval by ~22% during trial.
- Observed long-tail completions (>1000 tokens) account for 4% of requests but drive 18% of token spend.
Dedicated sizing sketch (SE recommendations):
- Baseline target: support steady 30 QPS sustained for chat-generations with headroom for normal growth (6 months).
- Peak plan: handle bursts up to 150 QPS via autoscale/burst capacity (mix of reserved + burst).
- Token throughput estimate: steady-state token TPS ~ (25 QPS * 510 tokens avg) = ~12.75k tokens/sec; peak token TPS ~ (120 QPS * 510) = ~61.2k tokens/sec.

- Suggested Dedicated config: 2 x A100-equivalent GPUs for baseline (good for 25-40 QPS steady depending on model), autoscale to 4 GPUs for peak windows; or 3 GPU reserved + 1 burst node to optimize cost/commitment.
- Model routing: route ~60% traffic to quantized 7B variant (low cost), 30% to 13B variant for higher quality, 10% to dedicated embedding service (separate pool).
- Concurrency & batching: target single-GPU concurrency 8-12 with batching window 8-12ms; set per-route SLOs to preserve 95th latency under 800ms.
Pricing conversation notes:
- Customer prefers committed monthly capacity rather than pure usage; asks for 12-month reserved with 20-30% discount + 10% monthly burst pool.
- Wants clear metric mapping: tokens/month vs GPU-hours vs expected QPS — asked for Redwood to provide 'traffic forecast template' (SE action).

- Clarify EU data residency path for Dedicated VPC — need region pinning confirmation and KMS behavior across regions.
